Pip Copperwink — level 1

The charming burglar with a duelist’s smile.

Halfling Shadow · HP 16/16 · Grit 2/2 · Speed 7 squares · Bulk 10/10.

Languages: Common and Halfling. See the @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.b65e9644d24629f2.JournalEntryPage.0237eee3512bbfa9]{language reference}.

Attributes and ancestry

BrawnFortitudeAgilityGuileKnowledgeReason
+0+0+2+2+0-1

Total +3. Shadow minima: Agility, Guile ≥ 0; met. Mental sum +1, so each stage’s base pool is 11 DP.

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.32afe77bcb9f00a1.JournalEntryPage.b39265b53fcf58e8]{Under Their Noses}: You fit through openings the DA judges suitable for your actual small size, and gain 1 Boon to hiding behind ordinary furniture that plausibly conceals you. Standing creatures still block their squares; no free movement through enemies. - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.cba4ce77e3253c0a.JournalEntryPage.69c266abd0aebc93]{Quiet as a Burrow}: Gain 1 Boon to quiet movement outside combat. On a Strong result, one willing companion following your route gains 1 Boon to their next quiet-movement roll this scene. You cannot confer Hidden by walking in open view.

Level 1 — class and purchases

Choose @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.659f046648036560.JournalEntryPage.6f9998008dd8a1fb]{Shadow}. Class grants Subterfuge 1 and Athletics 1; 1 duplicate(s) give +1 DP, not higher ranks. Free signature: @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.7ffedf579af69498.JournalEntryPage.bf2ae4b6f74e0a1c]{Fade Behind}. Its use procedure follows; the linked card remains the complete reference:

Action: Passive · Attribute: None — no roll

Target / range / shape: Self, when you use Disengage.

As part of Disengage, move up to 2 squares without provoking. This additional movement makes no audible footfalls but does not silence speech or deliberately used equipment. It does not grant Hidden in open view; actual concealment still matters.

Duration: Immediate movement; Disengage lasts for this turn.

Equipment / acquisition: None.

Signature limit: Once on your turn.

Fresh pool: 11 + 1 = 12 DP. All discipline purchases below occur before cards that need them.

HP: 12 + ancestry 1 + class 3 + Fortitude 0 + trait 0 + Conditioned Body 0 = 16. Capacity: 10 + 3 × Brawn (0) = 10. Granted Bulk 3 + purchased Bulk 7 = 10, so encumbrance penalty 0. Speed: ancestry 5 + Agility 2 + trait 0 = 7.

Physical resistance: 0. Other resistances: 0. Wounds and death marks: 0. Grit: 2. No HP or Grit has been spent during creation.

Starting coins and market purchases are resolved in the shopping ledger below. Card-granted equipment is not purchased again. Repeated compatible weapon/tool grants supply no duplicates.

Recipes: none granted or purchased.

At the table

Smile Before Steel lets Pip fight with Guile; Sell the Feint prepares that attack. Quiet Latch and the illusion/voice cards support infiltration. Fade Behind adds quiet movement to Disengage but never makes open ground concealment. Quick Exit adds one available movement square when Pip Disengages, once per turn; it does not change his Speed. The sword stays in one hand, leaving the other available. Courtesy and Invitation use that same sword rather than granting spares.

Complete learned-card checklist

These are all origin grants, purchases and the free signature; there is no equipped-card limit. Universal references are supplied separately.
